Hi all, 

I am new to INLA, I am managed to fit a simple and idd logistic regression model using the code below which worked out fine

#fitting Model that accounts for random effects that is non-spatial (iid), 

form_10to18 <- y ~ wealth_2 + edu_a + net_use + hh_size + ACT_use_u5 + pop_den + 
  hh_members_age + sex_f + annual_precipitation


all_iid <- inla(update(form_10to18, . ~. + f(id_variable, model = "iid")),
                   data = as.data.frame(dat_df), family='binomial',
                   control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
                   control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE)
)
summary(all_iid)

However, when I try to smooth one of the variables using bym argument to account for the effect neighboring spacial points would have on the variable. I created a matrix that joins the spatial points based on the distance (KM) apart using the code below. 

#craeting neighbors with 10km
coordinates(dat_sf) <- ~ LONGNUM + LATNUM
neib <- dnearneigh(coordinates(dat_sf), 0, 10, longlat = TRUE)

formula_nieb = y ~ wealth_2 + edu_a + net_use + hh_size  + pop_den + 
  hh_members_age + sex_f + annual_precipitation + f(ACT_use_u5 , model ="bym", graph = neib)
# Run model
result = inla (formula_nieb ,family = " binomial ", data = dat_df)
